fusions.name: Headfirst Heave
fusions.desc: Drives your head into the target, dealing 13 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Foothold
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Shoves it off its feet, dealing 20 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Planted Curl
fusions.desc: You curl up and take no damage for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Grudge
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 8% higher at all times.
